notes: Version 2.3 names the hypothesis on which the restriction of the algebraic structure of the admissible fibre depends: under a representation-theoretic dictionary, the admissibility axioms restrict that structure only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived, on which a decomposition stable under the admissible generators counts as premature selection (Foundation version 2.6, Lemma 5.6). No other statement is changed; the results of the note are unchanged.
